key_assumption: The invasion has already priced in all risks, leading to a lack of significant market reaction beyond the initial sell-off.

transmission_channels.description: Pricing-in of fear may have already occurred, reducing market impact.
Potential buying pressure as uncertainty resolves, though not fully priced in yet.

channel_assessment: The Geopolitical Risk Premium is over-weighted, while the Relief Rally is under-weighted. The invasion may lead to a relief rally if sophisticated investors haven't hedged sufficiently.

other_factors.description: Potential for further energy gains despite Fed constraints.
